## Updating no longer wipes your settings

**If you've ever noticed the device coming back factory-fresh after a flash — theme reset, background reset, the first-boot walkthrough playing again — that was a real bug, and this release fixes it.**

The web flasher shipped a single merged image and wrote it starting at flash offset 0. Merging pads the gaps between the bootloader, the partition table and the app with `0xFF`, and one of those gaps is exactly where NVS lives (0x9000, 20KB) — the partition holding every saved setting, your pet count, and the "already saw the walkthrough" flag. So every install wrote 20,480 bytes of erased-state straight over it. Checked against the shipped v1.4.1 image: all 20,480 bytes of that range were `0xFF`. The flasher now writes the three real regions at their own offsets instead, which leaves NVS completely untouched — the same thing `pio run -t upload` has always done, which is why this never showed up during development.

One catch worth knowing: **the update that installs this release will still reset your settings**, because the image currently on the flasher page is the old kind. Settings you change after that flash are the ones that stick.

Also in this release, a first pass of cleanup found by auditing the build: **22.8KB of flash freed**, and the WiFi capture path stopped wasting its very limited queue on frames that could never match anything. That queue holds 7 entries and is drained once per rendered frame, so a slot spent on a broadcast address was a slot a real detection couldn't have.

### The actually-useful part
- **Fixed**: the web flasher wiping NVS on every update — saved settings, pet counts and the seen-the-walkthrough flag now survive a firmware update
- **Fixed**: broadcast and multicast destination addresses no longer consume slots in the WiFi detection queue; they can't match any vendor OUI, so they were pure waste in the one place the device has least room to spare
- **Fixed**: a dead `copyMac()` helper that also had a latent format bug (five format specifiers, six arguments) — never called, now gone
- **Changed**: dropped five TFT_eSPI fonts and the smooth-font renderer that nothing could reach — the UI uses only the built-in font plus its own Bangers glyphs, so this is 22.8KB of flash back (37.3% -> 36.6%) with no visible change
